\[A=\{2,4,6,8,10,12\}, B=\{4,8,12,16,20\}, C=\{8,16,24,32,40\}, \text { and } D=\{10,20,30,40,50\} \nonumber \]

For the following exercises, use the sets provided to apply the “AND” or “OR” operation as indicated to find the resulting set.

\[\begin{aligned} U & =\{a, b, c, \ldots, z\}, S=\{s, a, m, p, l, e\}, M=\{m, a, p\}, L=\{l, a, m, p\}, D=\{d, o, g\}, \text { and } \\P & =\{p, l, o, t\} \end{aligned}  \nonumber \]

Exercise \(\PageIndex{13}\)

Find the set consisting of elements in \(S\) and \(P\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{21}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{25}\)

Find \(A \cup B\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{26}\)

Find \(A \cap B\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{27}\)

Find \((A \cap B)^{\prime}\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{28}\)

Find \((A \cup B)^{\prime}\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{29}\)

Find \(A \cap B^{\prime}\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{30}\)

Find \(B \cap A^{\prime}\).

[Figure: A two-set Venn diagram intersecting one another is given. The first set is labeled A while the second set is labeled B. Set A shows p, l. Set B shows b, r, s. The intersection of the sets shows a, c, e. Outside the Venn diagram, it is marked U equals (a, b, c, … , z).]

Exercise \(\PageIndex{31}\)

Find \(A \cap B\).

[Figure: A two-set Venn diagram, A and B, where A is inside B is depicted. The numbers 1, 2, 3, and so on are marked at the center of set A. The number 0 is found on set B. Outside the Venn diagram, it is marked U equals Z. Z equals (Minus 2, Minus 1, 0, 1, 2).]

Exercise \(\PageIndex{37}\)

Find \(A \cup B\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{38}\)

Exercise \(\PageIndex{42}\)

Find \(A \cap B^{\prime}\).

For the following exercises, determine the cardinality of the union of set \(A\) and set \(B\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{43}\)

If set \(A=\{\) red, white, blue \(\}\) and set \(B=\{\) green, white, red \(\}\), find \(n(A \cup B)\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{44}\)

If set \(A=\{\) silver, gold, bronze \(\}\) and set \(B=\{\) silver, gold \(\}\), find the number of elements in \(A\) or \(B\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{45}\)

If set \(A=\{\) glass, plate, fork, knife \(\}\) and set \(B=\{\) bowl, spoon, cup \(\}\), find the number of elements in \(A\) or \(B\).

Exercise \(\PageIndex{46}\)

If set \(A=\{\) Algebra, Geometry, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, English \(\}\) and Set \(B=\{\) Algebra, English, History, Spanish, French, Music \(\}\), find \(n(A \cup B)\).

For the following exercises, use the Venn diagram to determine the cardinality of \(A\) union \(B\).

[Figure: A two-set Venn diagram of A and B intersecting one another is given. Set A shows 2 while set B shows 8.  The intersection of the sets shows 7. Outside the Venn diagram, it is marked U equals 21.]

Exercise \(\PageIndex{48}\)

[Figure: A two-set Venn diagram, A and B, not intersecting one another is given. Set A shows 3 while set B shows 10. Outside the Venn diagram, it is marked U equals 21.]

Exercise \(\PageIndex{49}\)

[Figure: A two-set Venn diagram, A and B, where A is inside B is depicted. The number 22 is marked at the center of set A. The number 52 lies on set B. Outside the Venn diagram, it is marked U equals 44.]

Exercise \(\PageIndex{50}\)

[Figure: A two-set Venn diagram of A and B intersecting one another is given. Set A shows 15 while set B shows 4.  The intersection of the sets shows 18. Outside the Venn diagram, it is marked U equals 44.]
